description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Grid' used for rendering grid overlays in a graph plotting library. It includes methods for associating axes, calculating pixel positions, and rendering the grid in a plot area.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Grid
classes.description: A class that represents a grid overlay in a graph plotting context, associated with primary and secondary axes, and responsible for rendering grid lines on the plot area.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Grid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grid element, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: _setPrimaryAxis
methods.description: Associates a primary axis with the grid for reference.

methods.name: _setSecondaryAxis
methods.description: Associates a secondary axis with the grid.

methods.name: _getSecondaryAxisPoints
methods.description: Retrieves the data points on the secondary axis that the grid should connect.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Calculates the pixel X coordinate for a given data point based on the associated axes.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Calculates the pixel Y coordinate for a given data point based on the associated axes.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the coordinate boundaries of the grid element within the plot area.
